decisions.reason: Prospects are still uncertain and carrying costs are low, so the option value of the cleaning soap outweighs its cost.
As a core maintenance oil line with several models and no negative signals, its option value remains high and justifies keeping it.
The care product for oiled floors is still early and inexpensive to keep, so its unresolved option justifies retention.
The moisture-protection underlay is a low-cost complementary option whose demand uncertainty remains, so the option remains worth holding.
Although it overlaps with other underlay options, keeping costs are low and uncertainty persists, so the firm keeps the option open.
The oak parquet line is close to the firm's core and its option value from unresolved demand justifies continued commitment.
